question: What division of eight octads is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division of eight octads is named
The speaker seeks full knowledge of it
The knowledge is sought in an endless manner
inference: The speaker seeks to fully and endlessly know the division of the eight octads
uncertainties: The sense of anantathā as endlessly or in infinite detail is interpretive
plain_english: And to fully know the division of the eight octads in its endless extent.
